name: diagram-tools
description: Clear explanations, adaptive visual communication, validated diagrams, and reproducible publication figures.

interface.shortDescription: Explain mechanisms and create verified visual artifacts.
interface.longDescription: Visual Communication retains the diagram-tools plugin identity and its guarded runtimes. Explain Clearly chooses concise prose, diagrams, interactive causal explanations, or requested video through existing owners. Archify owns graphical maps; Pretty Mermaid owns explicit Mermaid, compact static diagrams, and terminal ASCII. Paper Figure Workflow supplies reproducible research plots and delegates native diagrams to their application owners. Bundled Visualize and installed Remotion remain external owners. Public sharing remains limited to accepted Archify HTML under the existing installation-specific opt-in.
defaultPrompt: Use $explain-clearly to explain the mechanism and choose a visual only when it helps understanding.
Use $paper-figure-workflow to create reproducible publication plots and editable diagrams.
Use $archify to create a validated interactive architecture or workflow map with retained typed JSON source.
Use $pretty-mermaid for explicit Mermaid, compact static diagrams, or terminal ASCII.
Render these Mermaid sources as terminal-friendly ASCII.
